arStrings.szText: "Have you figured out how to get rid of the blood?"
Astaroth’s not the only bleeder who’s dropped his rotten shite on our land. You remember Nafain? His cursed blood still chokes the moors.
Ever since you put him to rest, we’ve been purifying that blood, bit by bit—with a wolf spirit’s help. Hluttred. We think she can help with Astaroth’s blood, too.
The Druids will call on her in our ritual. We’ll need a Horadrim’s help, though, as the blood is still bound to their relics. That’ll be you.
Find the next relic, and pay respects to the spirits of the wood. Light a candle, tidy the space—whatever feels right.
